name: Diviner's Nose Chain

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

text: The diviner's nose chain is worn by attaching piercings to the ear and nose, creating a connection between the senses of hearing and smell. The diviner's nose chain grants you scent out to 30 feet as an imprecise sense, and a +1 item bonus to checks to Seek or Sense Motive.
